nodes.label: SQLSTATE / err.code
nodes.rationale: Branch on the five-character SQLSTATE, never on err.message. Messages are localised and version-dependent. Class 42 is always a bug (500), never a user 400. Socket failures are Node errnos, not SQLSTATEs. Test /^[0-9A-Z]{5}$/.

nodes.label: 23505 unique_violation
nodes.rationale: Map to HTTP 409. Match err.constraint, not just the code — a table can have several unique constraints. Insert-and-catch is the race-free check. 23505 fills constraint, not column; 23502 fills column.

nodes.label: Retryable 40001 and 40P01
nodes.rationale: Serialization failure and deadlock are isolation doing its job. Retry the whole transaction with backoff and jitter, not the failed statement. Connection errors retryable for reads; writes only if idempotent.

nodes.label: err.detail leaks data
nodes.rationale: detail contains the offending value (Key (email)=(a@x.com) already exists). Returning it enables user enumeration. Log detail; return your own message keyed off code and constraint.

nodes.label: FATAL errors arrive as events
nodes.rationale: When the server terminates a connection there may be no in-flight query to reject, so pg emits 'error' on the client or pool. Unhandled, the process dies. Reinforces pool.on('error').
